title: Actual quotient Roos augmentation compared with singleton Koszul unit
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and X a Noetherian scheme. Use the exact constant section transport F, small ring O and residue map q [def-sfb-internal-completion-section-transport]. Let a be any global section whose singleton list generates kernelIdeal(q) on every slice [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators]. Let P be K-flat in the actual integral module category [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], and D any RingedKoszulLimitPresentation(O,1,a) [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. There is an isomorphism from F(Q(actualRoos(P))) to D.completion(F(Q(P))) whose composite with F(Q(actualAugmentation(P))) is exactly D.unit(F(Q(P))). This compares actual augmented limits on representatives and does not assert a completeness equivalence.

source.place: Proof (1), completion comparison; constant-coefficient criterion (2)--(3); Stacks 099I, 099L, 099M

proof.text: Apply koszul_quotient_resolution to obtain the strict quasi-isomorphism q from the singleton Koszul tensor tower to the transported actual quotient tower, including its ordinary-limit unit identity.

Apply quotient_roos_limit to D.inverseLimit with D.comparison, its right-derived property and computation on K-injective towers. This gives the augmented actual Roos comparison e with the derived limit of the strict actual quotient tower.

Compose D.completion.mapIso(complexIso(P)), D.inverseLimit.mapIso(D.tensorFactors.app(complex(P))) and D.inverseLimit.mapIso(Q(q)) to obtain b from D.completion(F(Q(P))) to D.inverseLimit(Q(quotientComplex(P))). Naturality of D.unit, its formula on complexes, naturality of D.comparison at q, and the ordinary-unit equation give D.unit ≫ b.hom = F(Q(actualAugmentation(P))) ≫ e.hom. Hence e ≪≫ b.symm is the required comparison; postcompose that identity with b.inv to get the required unit equation. The reused private unit_naturality and unit_app_Q are proved localization calculations from the flat-scalar module; no scalar-comparison theorem is used.

lean.statement:
theorem quotient_koszul_unit_comparison [IsNoetherian X]
    (a : ((ring l E X).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (ha : ∀ U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X,
      IsRingedIdealGeneratingList (ring l E X)
        (ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (residue l E X)).module
        (ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (residue l E X)).inclusion U 1
        (fun _ ↦ a.val (op U)))
    (P : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (D : RingedKoszulLimitPresentation (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)) :
    ∃ e : (functor l E X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (AdicCompletion.roos l E X P)) ≅
        D.completion.obj ((functor l E X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)),
      (functor l E X).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (AdicCompletion.augmentation l E X P)) ≫
        e.hom = D.unit ((functor l E X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
